label: flaky if >=1 pass in 30 reruns; not flaky if 30/30 fail; setup failures excluded

rule.headline: ET-BF beats comparator by >=0.05 MCC in E1 (time-ordered) and E2 (leave-one-project-out), project-bootstrap 95% CI excl 0; and ET-BF beats ET-B by >=0.02 in E1
rule.context: ET-BFC - ET-BF >= 0.02 in E1 and no worse in E2
rule.minimum_sample: 60 flaky and 60 not flaky across >=4 projects, else descriptive only
